Ap$(do
	{Boil do {Sx var} {Sy var} {Sz var} {X var} {Y var} {Z var} {R var} {W var}}
	{Mandelbulb locparMem (4)}

	<{Scale float} [Mandelbulb]>
	<{Power float} [Mandelbulb 1%4]>
	<{BailoutR float} [Mandelbulb 2%4]>
	<{Iso float} [Mandelbulb 3%4]>

	<{dx float} (- [Sx] [X])>
	<{dy float} (- [Sy] [Y])>
	<{dz float} (- [Sz] [Z])>

	<{sx float} (/ dx Scale)>
	<{sy float} (/ dy Scale)>
	<{sz float} (/ dz Scale)>

	<{r float} (hypot sx (hypot sy sz))>
	<{theta float} (atan (hypot sx sy) sz)>
	<{phi float} (atan sy sx)>

	<{rp float} (** r Power)>
	<{thetaP float} (* theta Power)>
	<{phiP float} (* phi Power)>

	<{mx float} (* rp (* (sin thetaP) (cos phiP)))>
	<{my float} (* rp (* (sin thetaP) (sin phiP)))>
	<{mz float} (* rp (cos thetaP))>

	<{drx float} (+ mx sx)>
	<{dry float} (+ my sy)>
	<{drz float} (+ mz sz)>

	<{r2 float} (hypot drx (hypot dry drz))>
	<{boundWindow float} (sigmoid (* 8 (- [R] (hypot dx (hypot dy dz)))))>
	<{bailWindow float} (sigmoid (* 8 (- BailoutR r2)))>

	<{mandelDensity float} (* boundWindow (- Iso (* Scale r2)))>
	<{mandelDensity2 float} (* bailWindow mandelDensity)>

	(Diffeq poten$ mandelDensity2)
)
